speaker: Mr Png Eng Huat
text: asked the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth with regard to the Report of the Auditor-General for FY2018/2019, what is the reason for the AGO's conclusion that it may be too late to recover the overpayment of $13 million from the contractor in its audit finding of improper waiver of contractual provision for the National Gallery development project.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: MCCY provided funding for this project to be directly managed by NGS so as to achieve greater efficiency and savings from aligning the design and construction to its operational requirements.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: NGS duly executed all contracts under its purview to deliver the project on time and below budget.

speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
text: During the course of the project, NGS addressed all findings from MCCY's progressive audits.

speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
text: I would broadly explain that this $13 million probably has two main audit findings from AGO.

speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
text: The first are specific items of claims amongst quantity agreements and so on.

speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
text: This part of the work is still being finalised and, in order not to compromise our position, I would not say how it would go one way or another.
